releaseNotes: Add SchedulesScreen with schedule and task management functionality
changelog: Implemented SchedulesScreen for displaying, creating, editing, and deleting schedules and tasks.
Added ScheduleCard and TaskRow components for better UI representation.
Integrated PullToRefresh for refreshing schedule data.
Included dialogs for schedule and task creation/editing.
Added confirmation dialogs for deletion of schedules and tasks.
Created SchedulesParsingUnitTest to validate JSON parsing for schedules and tasks.
Added tests for schedule list parsing, single schedule item parsing, and serialization of ScheduleRequest and ScheduleTaskRequest.
